Don't build another front end with Claude until you've installed these five free repos.

The first is UI UX Pro Max, which just crossed 116,000 stars. It gives Claude actual design intelligence, layouts, palettes, typography, so your agent stops guessing at what looks good.

The second is Taste Skill, at 76,000 stars. It's built for one job, killing AI slop, so your site stops looking like every other Claude build.

The third is Awesome Claude Design, 68 design systems ready to go. Just drop one into your project, so you never start from a blank page again.

The fourth is design-md-chrome. Open any site you like, hit the extension, and it pulls the whole design system out, so you never describe a style from scratch.

And finally, Design Motion Principles. Most AI design just sits there, so this one adds real motion, timing and easing to everything you build.

So if you guys want all five, just comment DESIGN down below and I'll send you the links directly.
